Name: ToolSense - Smart AutoTool
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[center][img width=409]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795527261-1722016645.png[/img][/center]
Coming from the mobile version of Stardew Valley, moving to PC made me realize something I'd never thought twice about before: just how much time goes into manually swapping tools. Chopping wood, mining rocks, watering crops—constantly switching hotbar slots quickly became a tiny, repetitive speed bump in an otherwise relaxing game.
That minor friction is what sparked [color=#93c47d][b]ToolSense.[/b][/color]
[color=#93c47d][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] makes interacting with the world feel second nature. It recognizes your target, pulls the right tool from your inventory on the fly, and restores your previous slot the moment you finish. Alongside smart tool selection, it brings habit learning, combat support, customizable targeting modes, and automatic furnace prep—everything you need for a smoother, more intuitive farming experience.

[img width=866]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795510601-1436356639.gif[/img]

[center][img width=445]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795527467-797082192.png[/img][/center]
[heading][quote][b][color=#00ffff]1. Intelligent Automatic Tool Selection[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler][color=#00ffff][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] automatically recognizes supported targets and selects the most suitable available tool from your inventory, so you can focus on playing instead of constantly switching toolbar slots.
[list]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Axe:[/color][/b] Automatically selects an axe for trees, stumps, and other suitable targets.[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Pickaxe:[/color][/b] Selects a pickaxe for rocks, boulders, resource clumps, and other suitable targets.[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Hoe:[/color][/b] Selects a hoe for artifact spots and designated diggable targets. Optionally, it can also select a hoe when targeting empty, diggable ground.[/*]
[*][color=#00ffff][b]Watering Can:[/b] [/color]Automatically selects a watering can when targeting dry soil and crops that need watering.[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Scythe:[/color][/b] Selects a scythe for grass, weeds, and suitable crops.[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Water Management:[/color][/b] Automatically selects your watering can when its water level falls below your configured refill threshold.[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Fishing Rod:[/color][/b] Automatically selects your fishing rod when targeting water if your watering can doesn't need refilling.[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Copper Pan:[/color][/b] Automatically selects your pan when targeting shimmering water spots.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#00ffff]ToolSense[/color][/b] searches your entire inventory for suitable tools, prioritizes higher-upgrade tools, and avoids unnecessary switching between equally suitable options.
[b][color=#00ffff]Optional protection settings[/color][/b] help prevent accidental damage to young trees, fruit trees, tapped trees, and giant crops.[/spoiler]

[img width=340]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795510635-1661746194.gif[/img][img width=340]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795510700-2006015940.gif[/img]
[heading][quote][b][color=#e06666]2. Combat Assist & Combat Mode[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler]Stay ready for combat without constantly managing your toolbar. [color=#e06666][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] helps you equip the right weapon and maintain it when enemies are nearby.
[list]
[*][b][color=#e06666]Combat Assist:[/color][/b] Automatically selects the melee weapon with the best estimated time to defeat the targeted monster, based on its damage potential and the monster's resilience.[/*]
[*][b][color=#e06666]Auto-Equip on Attacked:[/color][/b] Can automatically equip a weapon when you are attacked.[/*]
[*][b][color=#e06666]Aim Assist:[/color][/b] Helps identify nearby monsters within your configured detection radius and aiming angle.[/*]
[*][b][color=#e06666]Lead Targeting:[/color][/b] Accounts for monster movement when determining the best target.[/*]
[*][b][color=#e06666]Combat Mode:[/color][/b] Keeps your weapon equipped while enemies are nearby, preventing unwanted switches to regular tools when targeting grass, soil, or water.[/*]
[*]Customize combat detection range, aim assist radius, aiming angle, lead time, and weapon restoration delay.[/*]
[*]Optionally ignore Slimes inside the Slime Hutch.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[img width=339]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1794850196-2049131861.gif[/img]
[heading][quote][b][color=#9900ff]3. Hold to Retarget & Target Stability[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler]Designed for continuous gameplay, these features help [color=#9900ff][b]ToolSense [/b][/color]respond naturally as you move between targets.
[list]
[*][b][color=#9900ff]Hold to Retarget:[/color][/b] Continuously checks the target while holding the use-tool button, automatically switching tools as you move between targets.[/*]
[*][b][color=#9900ff]Target Stability:[/color][/b] Reduces unnecessary tool switching when moving your cursor across multiple targets by requiring a new target to remain stable for a configurable number of consecutive checks.[/*]
[*]Initial tool selection is never delayed by [color=#9900ff][b]Target Stability.[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[heading][quote][b][color=#ff00ff]4. Smart Restore[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler][b][color=#ff00ff]ToolSense[/color][/b] remembers your original toolbar selection before automatically switching tools, then restores it once the action sequence is complete.
It also coordinates restoration across different activities, including regular tool use, combat, and furnace preselection.
[list]
[*]Automatically restores your previous toolbar selection.[/*]
[*]Customize the restoration delay.[/*]
[*]Disable [color=#ff00ff][b]Smart Restore[/b][/color] entirely if you prefer manual toolbar management.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[heading][quote][b][color=#f6b26b]5. Habit Learning & Modded Object Learning (v2)[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler]Not every player uses the same tools for the same situations.[b][color=#f6b26b] ToolSense[/color][/b] learns from your repeated manual choices and gradually adapts to your preferences.
[b][color=#f6b26b]Habit Learning[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Learns from repeated manual tool overrides after ToolSense makes a selection.[/*]
[*]Applies learned preferences to the same type of target in future interactions.[/*]
[*]Customize how many manual overrides are required before a preference is learned.[/*]
[*]Learned habits are saved separately for each save file.[/*]
[*]Forget learned habits whenever you like.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#f6b26b]Modded Object Learning[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Encountered an object added by another mod that ToolSense doesn't recognize? Just use your tools manually until you successfully interact with it.[/*]
[*][b][color=#f6b26b]ToolSense[/color][/b] observes successful tool usage and learns which tool works for that object.[/*]
[*]Automatically selects the learned tool the next time you encounter that object.[/*]
[*]Learned object knowledge is shared across all save files.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[quote][b][color=#c27ba0][size=5]6. Other Smart Interactions[/size][/color][/b][/quote][spoiler][color=#d5a6bd][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] provides additional automation for specialized interactions beyond regular tool selection.

[b][color=#d5a6bd][u]Furnace Ore Selection & Preselect[/u][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Furnace Ore Selection:[/color][/b] Automatically selects a suitable ore from your inventory when interacting with an idle furnace, provided you aren't already holding a suitable ore.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Furnace Preselect:[/color][/b] Automatically prepares a suitable ore before you interact with a nearby idle furnace.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Smart Suggestions:[/color][/b] Prioritizes suitable ores based on your available inventory and previous selections.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Ore Rotation:[/color][/b] Helps avoid repeatedly suggesting the same ore type when other suitable options are available.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Coal Requirement:[/color][/b] Optionally requires you to have Coal before suggesting ore for a furnace.[/*]
[*][b][color=#d5a6bd]Custom Ore Preferences:[/color][/b] Enable or disable suggestions for Copper, Iron, Gold, Iridium, Radioactive, and other ores.[/*]
[*][color=#d5a6bd][b]HUD Notification:[/b] [/color]Displays the suggested ore when Furnace Preselect activates.[/*]
[/list][color=#d5a6bd][b]Furnace Preselect[/b] [/color]only selects the ore for you. It does not automatically load the furnace.

[b][color=#ff7700][u]Animal Tool Selection[/u][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#ff7700][b]Automatic Harvesting Tools:[/b] [/color]Automatically selects the Milk Pail or Shears when targeting an animal ready for tool-based harvesting.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Modded Animal Support:[/color][/b] Recognizes compatible custom animals through their harvesting data, without relying on hardcoded species names.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Smart Detection:[/color][/b] Only switches tools when the targeted animal is ready for harvesting.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Inventory Search:[/color][/b] Finds the required tool anywhere in your inventory.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[heading][quote][b][color=#00ff00]7. Customization & Controller Support[/color][/b][/quote][/heading]
[spoiler]Fine-tune [b][color=#00ff00]ToolSense[/color][/b] to match your personal playstyle.
[list]
[*]Configure individual tool selection and gameplay behaviors.[/*]
[*]Customize tree protection, target detection, combat settings, and restoration delays.[/*]
[*]Adjust watering can refill thresholds and furnace preselection settings.[/*]
[*]Enable or disable individual learning systems.[/*]
[*]Toggle ToolSense on or off using a configurable hotkey.[/*]
[*]Optional toolbar status indicator shows when ToolSense is enabled.[/*]
[*]Supports [b][color=#00ff00]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/color][/b] for convenient in-game configuration (optional dependency).[/*]
[*]Controller support for toggle hotkeys, including controller buttons and button combinations.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[center][img width=434]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795527747-1384846115.png[/img][/center]
[spoiler][color=#ffff00][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] now gives you full control over how targets are detected, instead of locking you into standard mouse-cursor aiming. Head into [b][color=#ff7700]GMCM → General Settings[/color][/b] to switch between four distinct modes tailored to your playstyle:

[b][color=#3c78d8]True Cursor (Default)[/color][/b]
Preserves 100% of the classic [b][color=#3c78d8]ToolSense[/color][/b] behavior you already know. It strictly targets the exact tile directly beneath your mouse cursor—offering the highest pinpoint accuracy and serving as a reliable, all-around choice for any player.

[img width=317]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795524605-589978031.gif[/img]
[b]
[color=#00ffff]Cursor Gaze (Author's Pick)[/color][/b]
Whenever you click anywhere on screen, your farmer automatically turns to face that direction right before swinging or using a tool. While it shares the same core logic as [color=#00ffff][b]True Cursor[/b][/color], it removes awkward directional locking and feels noticeably smoother and more responsive—a great upgrade for everyone, especially if you enjoy fluid, natural movement.
[img width=320]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795524636-1915067928.gif[/img]
[b]
[color=#9900ff]Cursor Sweep[/color][/b]
Expands the detection radius around your cursor instead of checking only a single tile. This trades a bit of pinpoint precision for a wider catch zone, making rapid, repetitive actions on the same type of resource much faster. It shines in places like the Mines or dense tree farms, though it isn't recommended for everyday casual play around delicate crops or decorations.
[img width=324]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795524692-1275027082.gif[/img]

[b][color=#ff0000]Player Forward[/color][/b]
Ignores the mouse cursor completely and determines targets purely based on the direction your farmer is currently facing. Designed specifically for keyboard-only or controller players—or anyone who prefers a classic console-style experience without having to aim with a mouse. Highly recommended for controller users.
[img width=327]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795524733-1699801082.gif[/img][/spoiler]

[center][img width=407]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795527830-1695515892.png[/img][/center]
Before using [b][color=#ff7700]ToolSense[/color][/b], please keep the following points in mind:
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Avoid using other automatic tool-selection mods.[/color][/b] If you are already using another mod with functionality similar to [color=#ff7700][b]ToolSense[/b],[/color] I strongly recommend not using it alongside [b][color=#ff7700]ToolSense[/color][/b], as conflicts may occur.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Compatibility:[/color][/b][color=#ff7700] [b]ToolSense[/b][/color] is currently at its first release. It may not be fully compatible with certain mods that modify toolbar behavior or tool selection. Compatibility may be improved in future updates.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Recommended Settings:[/color][/b] The default [color=#ff7700]GMCM[/color] configuration is recommended for the intended gameplay experience. Unless you have a specific reason to change something, I recommend keeping the default settings.[/*]
[/list][center][img width=464]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795528006-1501497363.png[/img][/center]
[list=1]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Install SMAPI[/color][/b] (version 4.0.0 or later) if you haven't already.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Download ToolSense[/color][/b] and extract the downloaded ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Move the
[code]ToolSense-AutoTool[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to configure ToolSense directly in-game.[/*]
[/list]That's it! [b][color=#ff7700]ToolSense[/color][/b] is ready to use.
[b]Note:[/b] Make sure the folder structure looks like this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── ToolSense-AutoTool/
        ├── assets/
        ├── i18n/
        ├── AutoTool.dll
        ├── config.json
        └── manifest.json[/code][center][img width=429]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55292/55292-1795527931-2068387630.png[/img][/center]
[b][color=#00ff00]ToolSense[/color][/b] is still a new mod, so there may be issues that I haven't encountered during development or testing.
If you encounter any bugs, unexpected behavior, or compatibility issues, I would really appreciate it if you could report them in the Nexus comments or the Bugs section.
When reporting an issue, providing the following information would be very helpful:
[list]
[*]A description of the issue and how to reproduce it.[/*]
[*]Your SMAPI log.[/*]
[*]A list of other mods that may be related to the issue.[/*]
[/list]Your reports and feedback are incredibly valuable. They help me identify problems, improve compatibility, and make [b][color=#00ff00]ToolSense[/color][/b] better for everyone.
Thank you for trying [color=#00ff00][b]ToolSense[/b][/color] and supporting my work. And if you're enjoying the mod, don't hesitate to leave it an [color=#00ff00][b]Endorsement[/b]![/color] 💚
